events.verdict: Dinwiddie (BKN) reflexively places his arms around Simmons (PHI) as the pick is set and quickly releases without affecting his FOM.
Allen (BKN) makes marginal body contact that Embiid (PHI) is able to move through after his gather.
Embiid (PHI) plants his left foot, gathers the ball, and takes two legal steps before leaving the floor for the dunk.
Chandler (PHI) is actively guarding Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) within three seconds of being in the lane.
Chandler (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Harris' (BKN) defensive path and absorbs the contact.
Simmons (PHI) firms up in his screening position in Harris' (BKN) defensive path and absorbs the contact.
Allen (BKN) places and slightly extends his hands against Simmons' (PHI) backside, making marginal contact does not affect his ability to defend.
Chandler (PHI) places and slightly extends his hands against Dinwiddie's (BKN) backside, making marginal contact that does not affect his ability to defend.
Harris (BKN) is vertical and legally contacts the ball as he contests Embiid's (PHI) lay up attempt. 00:38.0                           00:26.5 00:38.0 To       00:26.5
Harris (BKN) sets the pick on Simmons (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Redick (PHI) places his hands against Dinwiddie's (BKN) front and makes contact as they move through the lane, but it is marginal in nature and does not affect his ability to defend the play.
[Observable in enhanced video]Redick (PHI) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) and Butler (PHI) dive to the floor and possess part of the ball as they attempt to retrieve the rebound. Jump ball is correctly assessed.
Crabbe (BKN) slightly extends his forearm into Chandler's (PHI) backside during the rebound, but the contact is marginal and does not dislodge him from his rebounding position.
Embiid (PHI) and Dinwiddie (BKN) engage and disengage without affecting the other's ability to retrieve the rebound.
Simmons (PHI) makes incidental contact with Crabbe (BKN) as they attempt to gain possession of the jump ball.
Embiid (PHI) gathers the ball on two feet, turns, and lifts his left foot, which establishes his right foot as his pivot. He then lifts his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Harris (BKN) and Simmons (PHI) engage with each other on the block and disengage without affecting the other's FOM.
